newsitem.title: GERMANY: Conti to forecast profit rise - Platow Brief.
newsitem.headline: Conti to forecast profit rise - Platow Brief.

text.p: German tyre group Continental AG was expected to forecast a distinct increase in profit for 1997 when it holds its annual meeting on Wednesday, the Platow Brief, a stock newsletter, reported.
The positive trends of the first quarter continued into April and March, the newsletter said in its Wednesday edition.
In the first three months of 1997, Continental's sales rose 1.4 percent to 2.52 billion marks, while pretax profit rose 17 percent to 88 million marks.

In April the company said it expected a "significantly pleasing" increase in profit for the year. Productivity gains and cost savings would allow a profit rise even as sales increased at a slower rate, the company said.
In 1996, net income rose 24 percent to 192.5 million marks while sales edged up 1.7 percent to 10.43 billion marks.
